title: 第3章 你这废物竟敢伤我！
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
周玄也是一脸的担忧。

    主要也是担心，万一陈默替自己出头得罪了陆瑶师姐。

    那就意味着一并得罪了林凤瑶和陆云。

    他们二人在青云宗外门可是有着举足轻重的地位，尤其是陆云，不仅是外门大长老的弟子而且还是陆瑶的亲哥哥。

    一旦和陆瑶发生了冲突那人家做哥哥的岂能善罢甘休？

    因此周玄看着他说道，“陈默这要不还是算了吧，犯不上为了一些灵石得罪陆云师兄。”

    “我看多一事不如少一事，这个月没有灵石咱们咬咬牙也就过去了。”

    “可要是得罪了陆云师兄，以后在这青云宗外门恐怕没咱们的好果子吃了。”周玄说道。

    陈默摆了摆手并没有在意这些他反而平静的说道，“不必担心。”

    “你只管带我去找陆瑶。”

    陈默说道。

    看到他坚持周玄本来还想继续劝说一番，可是见劝说无用也只好叹了一口气应允了下来。

    “那好吧。”

    “我可以带你去见陆瑶师姐，但是你见了面之后态度和言辞方面千万要注意。”

    “可不能得罪了陆瑶师姐。”

    “不然的话后果不堪设想，可不是咱们能承受得起的。”周玄说道。

    说完话周玄就带着陈默离开了院落这里，然后朝着陆瑶平日所修炼的方向。

    ……

    此时在青云宗外门一个山峰。

    在一片空地之上。

    陆瑶看着手上的这些灵石，其中有不少都是从外门弟子手上抢来的。

    陆瑶的性格比较刁蛮很是任性。

    这主要也是因为自己哥哥是陆云，整个青云宗外门有人护着自己，所以陆瑶早就习惯了这种唯我独尊的行事方式也没有人敢得罪自己。

    看着手上的这些灵石，陆瑶忍不住在心中笑道。

    “这些灵石都是从那些废物弟子手上抢来的。”

    “有了这些，我就能换取宗门内的资源提高我的修为和法术。”

    “至于那些废物的修炼关我屁事。”

    陆瑶说完话正准备收起这些灵石，准备开始修炼的时候。

    突然就在这时一个声音忽然传来。

    “把灵石交出来。”

    陈默的话音刚刚响起。

    此刻的陆瑶表情立刻就愣住了，一脸的震惊。

    目光投射过去看了一下那声音的出处。

    只见陈默和周玄二人朝这边走来。

    “周玄？”
content_en:
Zhou Xuan also looked worried.

    Mainly because he was worried that if Chen Mo stood up for him and offended Senior Sister Lu Yao.

    That meant offending Lin Fengyao and Lu Yun at the same time.

    The two of them have a very important position in the outer sect of Qingyun Sect, especially Lu Yun, who is not only the disciple of the great elder of the outer sect but also Lu Yao's brother.

    Once there is a conflict with Lu Yao, how can the elder brother let it go?

    So Zhou Xuan looked at him and said, "Chen Mo should just forget it. He can't offend Senior Brother Lu Yun for some spiritual stones."

    "I think it's better to do less than to do more. If there is no spirit stone this month, let's grit our teeth and get over it."

    "But if we offend Senior Brother Lu Yun, I'm afraid we won't have any good things to eat in the outer sect of Qingyun Sect in the future." Zhou Xuan said.

    Chen Mo waved his hand and said calmly, "Don't worry."

    "Just take me to find Lu Yao."

    Chen Mo said.

    Seeing his persistence, Zhou Xuan originally wanted to continue to persuade him, but seeing that the persuasion was useless, he had to sigh and agree.

    "Okay then."

    "I can take you to see Senior Sister Lu Yao, but you must be careful about your attitude and words after meeting."

    "You can't offend Senior Sister Lu Yao."

    "Otherwise, the consequences will be disastrous, and we cannot afford it." Zhou Xuan said.

    After saying that, Zhou Xuan took Chen Mo out of the courtyard and headed in the direction where Lu Yao usually practiced.

    …

    At this time, there was a mountain peak at the outer gate of Qingyun Sect.

    On a clearing.

    Lu Yao looked at the spiritual stones in her hands. Many of them were snatched from the hands of outer disciples.

    Lu Yao's character is quite unruly and willful.

    This is mainly because his brother is Lu Yun, and there are people in the outer sect of Qingyun Sect who protect him, so Lu Yao has long been accustomed to this kind of self-centered behavior and no one dares to offend him.

    Looking at these spiritual stones in her hands, Lu Yao couldn't help but smile in her heart.

    "These spiritual stones were snatched from those useless disciples."

    "With these, I can exchange for resources within the sect to improve my cultivation and spells."

    "As for the cultivation of those rubbish, it's none of my business."

    After Lu Yao finished speaking, she was about to put away these spiritual stones and start practicing.

    Suddenly at this moment a voice suddenly came.

    "Hand over the spirit stone."

    Chen Mo's voice just sounded.

    At this moment, Lu Yao's expression was immediately stunned, with a look of shock on her face.

    He cast his gaze over to see where the sound was coming from.

    I saw Chen Mo and Zhou Xuan walking this way.

    "Zhou Xuan?"
title_en: Chapter 3 You loser, how dare you hurt me!
